svg.title: P14N conditional run composite
svg.desc: All nominal half-peak cases remain unresolved. Eighteen sensitivity cases resolve under declared cross-run comparability assumptions, not physical current widths. Full bracketing observations span about 23 hours; all 126 outcomes are retained.
